caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section filled with a floral pattern set against a dark reddish-brown background with marbled, wavy lines. The composition features large green leaves with detailed veining, interspersed with assorted flowers in shades of pink, red, blue, and yellow. The flowers vary in size and form, some appearing as partially opened buds while others are fully bloomed, displaying layers of petals with highlights and shadows. The arrangement is dense, with leaves and blossoms overlapping each other, and some stems and smaller foliage branching out among the flowers. The overall effect covers the entire rectangular area, leaving a narrow margin of plain, textured off-white around the floral section. The artist's signature, "Geo. A. Loughridge," appears in small text at the bottom right corner of the floral section.
title: Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
